Frequently asked questions

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Plans are month-to-month and you can cancel or downgrade any time from the billing dashboard.

Do you offer a free trial?

The Starter plan is free forever. Paid plans include a 14-day trial with no credit card required.

Is my data secure?

Data is encrypted at rest and in transit, with SOC 2 Type II compliance and EU/US data residency options.
